The '''Utapaun flying squid''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]],<ref name="ICS" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with an arid surface<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> that featured deep [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkholes]] and powerful [[Hyperwind storm/Legends|hyperwind storms]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> At some point before Utapau's occupation by [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="ICS" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', which are concurrent with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems']] occupation of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Senin Vant's Porax-38 starfighter|Porax-38 starfighter]] later used by the [[Utapau Skyforce/Legends|Utapau Skyforce]] [[Air Commodore/Legends|Air Commodore]] [[Senin Vant/Legends|Senin Vant]] was taken on a joyride without its [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] being engaged. During the flight, an Utapaun flying [[Squid/Legends|squid]] impact left a noticeable dent and a smear on the [[Porax-38 starfighter|starfighter's]] right [[Wing (technology)|wing]], close to the [[Starship/Legends|craft's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].<ref name="ICS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Utapaun flying squid was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="ICS" />
